title: EFE classify log stream (v1.0)
description: Sprint D13. One event per Classify RPC. Used for drift detection, confidence calibration, anchor effectiveness analysis. Strictly metadata — NEVER contains user input text.

catalog_key.description: Canonical catalog key the classifier was running against.

predicted_class.description: Top-1 class chosen. Constrained by the catalog's class names.

tier.description: Discrete tier mapped from confidence + thresholds.

n_classes.description: Number of classes considered (matches catalog content).

n_swarm_rounds.description: Number of fusion rounds the swarm needed.

swarm_id.description: UUID v4 of the swarm execution. Useful for cross-RPC correlation in async pipelines.

rejected.description: True if the result was rejected (confidence below medium threshold).
